command:
$sdk = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "Android\Sdk"
$ctLatest = Join-Path $sdk "cmdline-tools\latest"
"=== STEP 1: download cmdline-tools ==="
$zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP "cmdtools.zip"
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-win-11076708_latest.zip" -OutFile $zip
"downloaded bytes: $((Get-Item $zip).Length)"
"=== STEP 2: extract ==="
$tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP "cmdtools"
if(Test-Path $tmp){ Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp }
Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $zip -DestinationPath $tmp -Force
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $ctLatest | Out-Null
Copy-Item (Join-Path $tmp "cmdline-tools\*") $ctLatest -Recurse -Force
"extracted"
"=== STEP 3: install packages ==="
$sm = Join-Path $ctLatest "bin\sdkmanager.bat"
& $sm --install "platform-tools" "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0" 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 6
"=== STEP 4: licenses ==="
1..40 | ForEach-Object { "y" } | & $sm --licenses 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 2
"licenses done"
"=== STEP 5: env vars ==="
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("ANDROID_HOME", $sdk, "User")
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT", $sdk, "User")
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("JAVA_HOME", "C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr", "User")
"env set"
"=== VERIFY installed ==="
& $sm --list_installed 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 12
